_nota: DEMO catalog of Dev B (F8). All output is labeled DEMO. The action texts are demonstration texts; the citations name the source of the rule when there is one. One rule for each one in the Monitoring catalog (rules/catalog/monitoring.json); tests/knowledge/test_rule_coverage.py cross-checks them.

passages.excerpt: Headache between 2.8 and 4.5 mmHg of ppCO₂; fatigue, poor sleep and nausea above 4.5 mmHg.
Hypoxia can cause mental changes sometimes imperceptible to the astronaut, reduced vision, fatigue, nausea, headache, dizziness and hyperventilation.
Space motion sickness lasts about 3 days on average.

rules.text: Early warning: ppCO₂ reaches or exceeds 2.5 mmHg (1 h average).

citations.excerpt: TB-004 (2.5 mmHg limit at 7 days, used as a pre-alert)

rules.text: The 1-hour average ppCO₂ exceeds the 3 mmHg limit of the standard.
Early warning: PIO₂ drops below 145 mmHg.

rules.text: PIO₂ is equal to or below 122 mmHg (1 h average).

rules.text: Pressure drops faster than the 13.5 psi/min limit.

revisar_ventilacion_y_filtros.title: Check ventilation and CO₂ filters
revisar_ventilacion_y_filtros.description: Make sure the fans and CO₂ filters work and are not saturated.

medir_co2_en_zonas_locales.title: Measure CO₂ in local zones
medir_co2_en_zonas_locales.description: Use a portable sensor in the zone where the value rises.

revisar_suministro_o2_y_presion.title: Check O₂ supply and pressure
revisar_suministro_o2_y_presion.description: Confirm the O₂ flow and the total cabin pressure.

reducir_esfuerzo_fisico.title: Reduce physical effort
reducir_esfuerzo_fisico.description: Lower the activity while oxygenation is verified.

verificar_sensores_y_estanqueidad.title: Verify sensors and leak-tightness
verificar_sensores_y_estanqueidad.description: Check that the pressure sensors read correctly and that there are no leaks.

comprobar_presion_en_zonas.title: Check the pressure in other zones
comprobar_presion_en_zonas.description: Compare the reading with sensors in other zones.

verificar_integridad_escotillas_y_sellos.title: Verify hatches and seals
verificar_integridad_escotillas_y_sellos.description: Inspect the hatches and seals of the affected zone.

aislar_zona.title: Isolate the zone
aislar_zona.description: Close the affected zone until the cause is confirmed.

verificar_composicion_atmosfera.title: Verify the atmosphere composition
verificar_composicion_atmosfera.description: Check the percentage of diluent and O₂.

revisar_sensor_n2.title: Check the N₂ sensor
revisar_sensor_n2.description: Check the calibration of the diluent sensor.

revisar_condensador_y_ventilacion.title: Check the condenser and ventilation
revisar_condensador_y_ventilacion.description: Inspect the condenser and the air flow.

comprobar_sensor_humedad.title: Check the humidity sensor
comprobar_sensor_humedad.description: Verify the reading against a reference instrument.

revisar_lazo_termico_y_ventilacion.title: Check the thermal loop and ventilation
revisar_lazo_termico_y_ventilacion.description: Check the thermal loop and the air flow.

comprobar_sensor_temperatura.title: Check the temperature sensor
comprobar_sensor_temperatura.description: Verify the reading against a reference instrument.

revisar_tendencia_en_la_zona.title: Review the trend in the zone
revisar_tendencia_en_la_zona.description: Look at the zone chart before acting.

verificar_estanqueidad_y_sellos.title: Verify leak-tightness and seals
verificar_estanqueidad_y_sellos.description: Check there are no leaks in the seals and hatches of the affected zone.

revisar_sensor_y_tendencia.title: Check the sensor and the trend
revisar_sensor_y_tendencia.description: Check that the sensor reads correctly and look at the zone chart before acting.
